description.narrative: The consultant is expected to provide the Ministry with a written report, based on both an examination of partners’ documentation and interviews. The consultant shall keep the Ministry informed of any information, gathered in the process of the assignment, that requires the Ministry’s attention. The consultant may organize the work following her or his experience in consultation and collaboration with the Ministry. The Ministry expects the consultant to meet with partners according to selection criteria agreed between the Ministry and consultant, based on an assessment of relevance, risk and representation of both Danish and non-Danish partners, as well as partners with differing grant values.
